Risk Description: ML credit scoring algorithm demonstrates disparate impact against demographic sub-populations in rural lending segments.
Existing Control: Manual sample audit of rejected loan applications
Recommended Treatment: Implement demographic parity constraints and Fairlearn bias mitigation pipelines.

Risk Description: Prompt injection attack bypasses chatbot system guardrails to exfiltrate customer account balances or operational context.
Existing Control: Basic regex keyword blocklist on input fields
Recommended Treatment: Deploy specialized LLM firewall (NeMo Guardrails / Lakera) and input sanitization layer.

Risk Description: Employees paste unmasked customer PII and internal financial data into public cloud LLM interface.
Recommended Treatment: Enforce enterprise API endpoints with zero-data-retention guarantees and endpoint DLP filtering.

Risk Description: Concept drift in consumer transaction behavior causes sudden spike in false positive fraud blocks during festival sales.
Existing Control: Static threshold alerts managed by fraud ops team
Recommended Treatment: Deploy automated model drift monitoring (Evidently AI) with continuous retraining pipelines.

Risk Description: Credit decisioning model acts as a black box unable to provide legally required adverse action explanations to rejected applicants.
Existing Control: Standard credit bureau score reason codes
Recommended Treatment: Implement SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations) explainability modules to generate applicant reason codes.
Owner: Head of Retail Credit & AI Lead

Risk Description: Low-quality scanned customer bank statements lead to erroneous income extraction and inflated credit limits.
Existing Control: Manual operator verification for flag cases
Recommended Treatment: Implement optical confidence score thresholding (>95%) with mandatory human review for low scores.

Risk Description: Deepfake video spoofing bypasses automated liveness verification during digital KYC onboarding.
Recommended Treatment: Upgrade to ISO 30107-3 compliant active 3D liveness detection and challenge-response protocols.

Risk Description: Chatbot generates hallucinated financial advice or incorrect interest rate quotes to retail banking customers.
Recommended Treatment: Enforce Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) restricted strictly to verified bank Knowledge Base docs.

Risk Description: Third-party document processing AI SaaS provider modifies training data handling policy without prior notice.
Recommended Treatment: Enforce contractual AI governance addendum and mandate annual third-party model security audits.

Risk Description: Failure to log model decision history for biometric KYC automated approvals breaching RBI Digital KYC guidelines.
Existing Control: Database application logs retained for 30 days
Recommended Treatment: Establish 10-year immutable audit log storage in WORM cloud buckets for all AI KYC approvals.

Risk Description: Unclear ownership matrix between Risk Data Science team and Fraud Operations when model fails to flag new UPI fraud vector.
Recommended Treatment: Formalize RACI governance matrix defining explicit model performance and operational escalation SLAs.

Risk Description: Over-reliance on AI document summarization leading to missed compliance clauses in commercial contract reviews.
Existing Control: Disclaimers on internal AI portal home page
Recommended Treatment: Mandate human legal counsel review for all contracts exceeding ₹10 Lakhs value.
